name: Armed and Ready
summary: You carry Morbent's Bane back to Sven Yorgen, the weapon forged to strip away Morbent Fel's unholy defenses.

sections.title: A Weapon Forged
sections.body: Morbent Fel's hold over Raven Hill cemetery resists ordinary steel. Blades shatter or glance off the dark wards around the necromancer. A weapon made to break those wards is now ready. Grimand Elmore shaped the metal in Stormwind's Dwarven District, and sacred power consecrated it. Morbent's Bane can now sever Fel's tie to unlife.

sections.title: Return to the Hermit
sections.body: Sven Yorgen waits at his lonely camp near Duskwood's western border, after the encroaching darkness brought ruin to his family, farm, and companions. You bring him Morbent's Bane, forged to break Morbent Fel's wards. Sven recognizes the weapon's divine craftsmanship and the fire in your eyes. With the weapon delivered, you can strike at the master of Raven Hill.

faq.answer: Morbent's Bane is a weapon forged and consecrated to break the magical wards surrounding Morbent Fel at Raven Hill.
Grimand Elmore, a blacksmith in Stormwind City's Dwarven District, fashioned the weapon from consecrated lightforge iron.

faq.q: Where do I deliver Morbent's Bane?
faq.answer: You deliver Morbent's Bane to Sven Yorgen at his camp in western Duskwood, near the Westfall border.

faq.q: Why can't Sven Yorgen fight Morbent Fel himself?
faq.answer: The dark forces in the woods drove Sven Yorgen from his home and cost him his family and companions. Isolated and hunted, he depends on Alliance champions to avenge them.

faq.q: What happens after completing Armed and Ready?
aliases: next quest after armed and ready
faq.answer: After Sven receives the blessed weapon, he sends you to Raven Hill Cemetery to face Morbent Fel and strike him down.

faq.q: What is the quickest route back to Sven's camp?
aliases: how to get to sven quickly
faq.answer: From Sentinel Hill in Westfall, travel east across the river to reach Sven's camp, a shorter and safer route than going west through Darkshire's dangers.

angles.text: As a paladin, you know how holy power joined with dwarven steel can break wards protecting the undead.
As a blacksmith, you can see how Grimand Elmore joined fine smithing with sacred rites to make a weapon against supernatural threats.
As an Alliance member, you see Stormwind artisans supply the expertise survivors in Duskwood need to confront the spreading blight.
